name: Thomson 43RT1055
summary: Thomson 43RT1055 ships with telemetry, ad services and partner installs. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Thomson set from India has only 1 GB of memory, and about 210 MB of that is free on the stock home screen. It ships with telemetry and ad services, content and promo apps, partner installs and background services. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It was checked on a real set in small batches with a screenshot after each. Live TV, HDMI and AV still switch, YouTube plays, and with a clean home screen the real remote's Home, Input, Settings, app buttons and mic work. A reboot re-enabled none of the apps. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Realtek Live TV app and the tuners
The remote's Input, Settings and mic keys
The main web view, Play Store and Play Services
notes: The remote is infrared, so there is no Bluetooth pairing to worry about.
Several apps are off by the owner's choice on this unit. Switch back on any you use.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Thomson 43RT1055?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Will it free up memory on my Thomson?
faq.a: It turns off background apps, which helps on a 1 GB set, but the page makes no speed promises. The stock home screen is the heaviest part, and a clean home screen is optional.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Thomson 43RT1055?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
